name: Labelkraft Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2022, Labelkraft Technologies Ltd deals in Scanners, Barcode Scanners & RFID Printers, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) LKTL is in the business of providing barcode code solutions, catering to industries including FMCG, logistics service providers, chemicals, garments etc. 
b) It supplies barcode printers, software, scanners, mobile computers etc. and also manufactures their consumables such as barcode ribbons, self-adhesive barcode and product labels in roll and sheet forms.
c) Company is also in trading of duty credit scrips required to pay customs duty by the importers. These scrips are transferable as per Foreign Trade Policy of Government of India. These are procured from exporters of various products and sold to importers for their customs duty payments.
d) Company also buys & sells duty credit licences like MEIS (Merchandise Exports from India Scheme), SEIS (Service Exports from India Scheme), RODTEP (Remissionof Duties  Taxes on Export Products Scheme), ROSCTL (Scheme for Rebate of State and Central Taxes and Levies on Export of Garments and Made-ups), etc. issued by Govt of India to exporters as incentive.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 32.2 to 25.0 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
